Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the IMDb page that clearly showed “Liam Garrigan as King Arthur” and incorrectly updated the understanding to claim it showed Elliot Knight as Merlin. This conflated two different Arthurian characters and shifted the target from King Arthur (the legendary figure from Historia Regum Britanniae) to Merlin, leading toward the wrong actor answer.
